text:
Nina (Billing): Heads up — invoice 100212 failed on card auth. Processor returned decline: MCC_RESTRICTION. Card is a corporate card tied to a travel/entertainment block. Customer says they can try a virtual card from their procurement platform or do a wire.
Carlos (Sales): Customer is Jules from NovaApps. They prefer virtual card (one-time virtual PAN) if we can accept it. If not, they'll wire. Need to confirm our ability to capture a virtual card and any extra fraud checks.
Jules (Customer): Hey team, sorry about the decline. Procurement can issue a single-use virtual card immediately. Will that work? We can also wire same-day if needed.
ops-payments-bot: Payment attempt logged: PAY-100212-AUTHFAIL. Decline code: MCC_RESTRICTION. Auto-retry scheduled in 24h.
Nina (Billing): Do not auto-retry — we should cancel since customer will attempt alternate payment. @ops-billing please cancel scheduled retries for 100212. Also, if virtual card is used, capture CVV and use immediate settlement flow.
ops-billing: Auto-retry cancelled for invoice 100212. Ticket BG-1002 created for payment method switch.
Erin (Finance): For virtual cards we need to ensure tokenization works with our gateway. Some virtual PANs mask cardholder name; require cardholder email & billing address for AVS. If they wire, route to our US operating account. I'll paste wire snippet below.
Erin (Finance): Wire details (USD):

````
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Clearing Bank
Account: 123456789
Routing (ABA): 021000021
Reference: INV-100212 / NovaApps PO-441
Currency: USD
````

Carlos (Sales): Jules — if you push the virtual card, capture a screenshot of the PAN expiry/CVV and send via secure upload link (we cannot accept full PAN over email). If wiring, include INV-100212 in reference.
Jules (Customer): Understood. I'll try virtual card first and will start wire as fallback. Sending virtual card details in the secure form now.
Nina (Billing): Once we get virtual card token, we'll attempt capture immediately and post a partial/complete receipt. If the virtual PAN declines again, notify sales and we'll move to wire.
ops-payments-bot: Received secure submission from Jules (tokenized data). Submission ID: SUB-7732.
Erin (Finance): Quick checklist for billing ops: 1) Confirm gateway supports single-use tokens 2) Run AVS with billing addr provided 3) If capture succeeds, issue receipt and close BG-1002. If capture fails, apply wire fallback WR-1003 and note attempted token in ticket.
Nina (Billing): Also adding note on invoice: "payment attempt blocked by issuer MCC restriction; customer provided virtual card; awaiting capture".
Carlos (Sales): One more ask from customer: can we allow split payment if virtual card only covers part? They might limit amount on the virtual PAN.
Erin (Finance): Yes — support split payments. If they pay partial by card, we'll set outstanding balance for wire. Disable auto retries (done) and tag invoice for manual reconciliation.
Jules (Customer): Virtual card capture succeeded and shows as settled on our side. Uploading bank confirmation for the remaining balance in case we need it.
ops-billing: Applied settled virtual card amount to invoice 100212. Open balance remains $5,400. Created wire request WR-1003 for remaining balance.
Nina (Billing): Thanks all. When WR-1003 posts, ops-billing please reconcile and mark invoice paid. I'll generate pro-rata receipt now then final receipt after wire.
Carlos (Sales): Great work. Jules — appreciate quick turnaround. :tada:
Jules (Customer): Thanks team!
